title: console_order_rejected event payload v0.2 (P0-E pre-issuance rejection)
description: ADR-0010 §14.21 项 3 / PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §5-§6: a blackboard action order written by blackboard_action_write was refused before execution. Unifies every pre-issuance rejection into the v0.2 event surface so the journal carries the structured rejection code (previously only the result-bar receipt + TraceStore did): order_stale / step_not_done / budget_insufficient (phase=pre_issue, step=protocol) and the issuance-time gates registry / contract / target / ACAF / policy / mode (phase=issue, step=registry|contract|target|policy; ACAF/mode/permission denials normalize to step=policy, code=policy_denied). step is the console failure-envelope step (never execute/verify — executed orders journal their outcome through tool_started/tool_completed). round/plan_epoch/run_id are the order's mechanical stamps and must match the preceding console_order_written record (verifier cross-check). The result-bar receipt remains the human-readable view.

order_id.description: The rejected order's identity (matches the preceding console_order_written order_id).

step.description: The console failure-envelope step: protocol for the pre-issue gates, registry/contract/target/policy for the issuance-time gates. Never execute/verify.

phase.description: pre_issue = rejected before issuance (order_stale / step_not_done / budget_insufficient); issue = refused at issuance time before any execution (registry / contract / target / ACAF / policy / mode gates).

code.description: Machine-readable rejection code (order_stale / step_not_done / budget_insufficient / unknown_service / invalid_arguments / out_of_scope / policy_denied / ...).

reason.description: Human-readable rejection message (the console error envelope message).
